authority: docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md (kitpip pin and the stub); NV-1, Linear TIN-7476 comment 9db389dc: the kitpip pin lives in a private record, and no kitpip repository URL or art enters this repository; the vrm renderer is the second avatar external, a draft (SPR-128, Linear TIN-7125 comment 33022456): registered here with no pin value, pinned in the same private record

resolve.check: sha256 and byte count against the pin, at plan and before every spawn

gate_states.commit_pinned_digest_pending: the pin names a source commit; no release binary digest exists yet, so the avatar stages stay blocked (kitpip_pin_pending)
gate_states.registered_hash_bound_not_accepted: the pin holds a release binary digest; renders are local and unaccepted until the operator's lip-sync and listening receipts
gate_states.test_fixture_not_a_release: the test-only record that pins the synthetic stub

engine.primary: three-vrm-chromium: @pixiv/three-vrm on three.js in headless Chromium, driven by Puppeteer or Playwright; each face frame sets expressions, look-at and head, then calls vrm.update(1/fps) once, so time advances only by frame steps
engine.fallback: blender-vrm: Blender with the VRM add-on, noted and not built
engine.lock: the engine's dependency lock is hash-bound in the pin (engine.lock_sha256); browsers are never downloaded in CI

protocol.version: RENDERER --version prints one JSON line {version, commit}
protocol.render: RENDERER render --vrm FILE --face FILE --size WxH writes raw RGBA8 frames (straight alpha, rows top-down) to stdout, exactly frames*W*H*4 bytes; its last stderr line is one JSON report {frames, step, renderer, gpu} or {refused, detail} with exit 1

vrm.frames_identity: per_host: GPU raster is not bit-exact, so frames_sha256 matches only another render on the same host, renderer and driver
vrm.records: avatars.json in the private records directory: one VRM model record per id (sha256, bytes, likenessConsent, approval, badge)

gates.likeness_consent: SP-R13: the model record's likenessConsent carries the Likeness scope, an evidence digest and no revocation (vrm_consent_missing, vrm_consent_revoked)
gates.appearance_approval: TIN-7130: approved by the operator for this model digest (vrm_approval_missing)
gates.edition: Internal only until a ruling after the 11-14 bench (vrm_edition_unruled); the demos keep kitpip (SPR-120)
gates.badge: open: no renderer draws a burned-in badge and no record may settle it (vrm_badge_undecided)

resolve.check: sha256 and byte count against the pin, at plan and before every spawn

gate_states.commit_pinned_digest_pending: the pin names a source commit; no renderer digest exists yet, so the avatar stages stay blocked (vrm_pin_pending)
gate_states.registered_hash_bound_not_accepted: the pin holds a renderer digest and an engine lock digest; renders are local and unaccepted until the operator's lip-sync receipt and the 11-14 bench
gate_states.test_fixture_not_a_release: the test-only record that pins the synthetic stub renderer
